lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Muse,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I need your help.
What's going on?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: There's this event called the Ark Music Awards.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: It's the biggest music awards show in the Ark.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: We need to remake our new song

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: for it.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: But you know how hard it was

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: for me to write this song in the first place.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I honestly have no idea what I'm supposed to do with it now.
What's the theme for the award show?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: It's gonna be super serious and formal.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Everyone'll be dressed up in gowns and suits.
Is T.T. STAR the only group performing?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: There'll be more than twenty groups performing that day

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: if you include the special performances.
Do you know what the other groups are doing?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Not yet.
If your concept's too similar to another group's, you won't stand out much.
Ask around and try to keep it different.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: That's not a bad idea,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: but if we just go with whatever genre's left

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: and end up with something that doesn't fit us,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: that could turn into a total disaster.
Fair point.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Sigh...
Or you could just go with the complete opposite concept?
Fans are kinda into that stuff.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: You mean changing the concept entirely?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: That might not be a bad idea.
Still,
wouldn't it be better to go with the concept you two really want to do?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: What Mint and I really want to do...?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Honestly, since this song already has such a strong mood to it,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I kinda wanted to try something brighter and bouncier, like our older songs.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Not sure if it would've worked, though.
Does that really matter?
You should just go with whatever you two would enjoy most.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I think you're right.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: You really are amazing, Muse. Thanks.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: If you're up for it, I can send you an invite to the awards show.
Yeah, I'd love to!

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Hehe, okay.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Anyway, I should get back to work.
Good luck!
